new_rig_adaptation.host_credit: Horse by sevketkabatas, CC BY4.0. Original mesh/UV/maps retained in declared derivative; source original remains unchanged.
new_rig_adaptation.rig_reference_credit: Rigged Mid-Poly Horse by antemeossa, CC BY4.0, https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/rigged-mid-poly-horse-fea999c1d8d64eb4a9c2bb1fac1e7d83. Four-limb rig/motion reference; not copied body geometry or anatomical certification.
new_rig_adaptation.adaptation: Source default world-skin surface baked to canonical metres, new source-specific26joint rig and topology-smoothed weights; original UV/index/material/image data retained. Old six incompatible serial-rig animations omitted from derivative playback, preserved in original separate source/BINprefix. All control placement and appearance remain reconstructed. No original joint/socket/gait compatibility.
